The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Two bugs were corrected in `rtl/uart_tx.v`:
1. `tx` was reset to `0` instead of `1`, violating the spec's idle-high requirement during reset.
2. `data_r` was updated on any `tx_start` pulse regardless of `busy`/state, so a `tx_start` asserted mid-frame would corrupt the byte currently being shifted out — now gated on `state == S_IDLE` so requests are properly ignored while busy.
